skills.description:
~~While Rukia's Battlefield Skill is active, all teammates' All-Type DMG increases by 15%.~~ 
 
 Rukia's Battlefield Skill uses two energy types: Battlefield Skill Energy and Chill, which releases two different Battlefield Skills: Icy Sword Wave and Chill release. Teammates' basic attacks, special attacks, and techniques increase Battlefield Skill Energy on hit. Cooldown: 0.2s. Triggering Breaking Ice adds 1 Chill. ~~Breaking Ice~~ 
 When any teammate attacks an enemy Frozen for more than 1s, triggers Breaking Ice once, dealing extra damage equal to 146.25% of Rukia's ATK and removing the normal Freeze effect. Enemies Frozen by the Ultimate can trigger Breaking Ice multiple times while Frozen, with a(n) 0.2s interval, but only the first trigger grants Chill. ~~Icy Sword Wave~~ Requires max Battlefield Skill Energy 
 Rukia appears on the field and releases a chilling sword wave to the enemy, dealing damage equal to 198% of ATK and inflicting 25 Freeze Point(s). ~~Chill Release~~ Requires 3 stacks of Chill 
 Rukia plants Sodenoshirayuki into the ground and releases all Chill, dealing damage equal to 391.5% of ATK to all enemies and Freezing them for 2s. She also creates a large Icy Realm. When any character attacks inside, Rukia releases an Ice Spike combo attack, dealing damage equal to 117% of ATK. This effect can only be triggered once per second. 
 
 The Ice Realm lasts 10s, and no additional realms can be created during this time.
skills.name: Pure Snow

skills.description: Use Flash Step to avoid attacks right before they hit. Perfect Dodges inflict True Time Freeze for 1.5 seconds, during which Rukia gains 15% ASPD and 25% MSPD for 4 seconds. Cooldown: 15s.
skills.name: Flash Step
